conversational-resume.description: Registered-tool resume boundaries and one fresh continuation; no provider calls.

runtime-resume.description: Managed Pi SDK reload and real registered-tool loop; isolated single extension, scripted provider, network forbidden.

quota-resume.description: Managed Pi SDK with pi-goal-x and the sibling pi-multi-account (PI_MULTI_ACCOUNT_ENTRY overrides): every account hits quota, the goal waits without retrying and resumes once by itself; scripted providers, network forbidden.

quota-resume-reload.description: Same, with an SDK reload during the quota wait: the goal recovers once and still resumes when quota returns.

windows-portability.description: Native paths, line endings, concurrent worker launch, shell selection and atomic-write fault injection.

integration.description: Registered handlers and GoalService integration with injected fixtures; no provider calls.

unit.description: Full offline unit suite through the repository adapters.
